argument_dependencies.text: The exposure of staff (E2) occurs downstream of the door-opening (E1) and is not necessary for, nor contributory to, achieving the goal of reaching the technician. Therefore the agent neither relies on staff as instruments nor uses them as means, preserving the side-effect interpretation while keeping the action itself (E1) as the intended means.
Mira does not rely on or use staff instrumentally.
